contracts_rationale: No HTTP/API or event interface changes; the only CLI surface change (--abort --release-branch/--reason) is specified in spec.md FR-008 and data-model.md.
purpose_context: Fixes two P0 consolidate rollback defects: a kill-left landing re-anchored by begin_attempt makes --abort falsely report a full restore (#5686), and the reconciliation-FAIL rollback discards a concurrent target commit by using the live tip as its CAS expectation (#5666).
purpose_tldr: Consolidate rollback and --abort anchor on the run's persisted record, never the live tip
